name: trtmc-agent-skills
description: Repo-local Codex skills for TensorRT-Model-Connect developer workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Repo skills for TensorRT, docs, and GitHub workflows
interface.longDescription: Installs TensorRT-Model-Connect Codex skills for GitHub PR workflow, documentation maintenance, model transformation, precision optimization, profiling, numerical debugging, and native TensorRT builder changes.
defaultPrompt: Use $write-git-messages to draft a PR message from my diff.
Use $submit-github-pr to push this branch and open a PR.
Use $debug-trt-mismatch to investigate a TensorRT vs HuggingFace mismatch.
Use $profile-model to profile a model and summarize bottlenecks.
